# Appendix A: Support Functions {#appndx_a}
## Data Helper Functions {#appndx_a.data_helper.functions}

### Data Loading

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
The complete source code of the functions described in this section is available in the the [Data loading](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/tree/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L5-L416) section of the [data-helper.R](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/tree/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L5-L416) script on _GitHub_.

#### [load_image.list](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) Function {#func.load_image.list}
\

Loads image data from the dataset files downloaded from [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/vaibhao/handwritten-characters) and stored under root directory specified by the [root_path] argument.

::: { #func.load_image.list.usage .sidebar }
##### [Usage](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-scripts/ds.train2trimmed_img.dat.R#L15)
\

```{r func@load_image.list.u, eval=FALSE}
  train.img_dat.list <- load_image.list(root_path = img.train_root.dir,
                                        fn.load_image.dat = load.img_trimmed,
                                        folder.list = NULL,
                                        char_files.max = NA,
                                        char_files.seed = NA,
                                        random_sample = FALSE)

```

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
In the *code snippet* above, a pointer to the auxiliary function [load.img_trimmed](#func.load.img_trimmed) described below in *this Section* is used as the value of the argument [fn.load_image.dat](#func.load_image.list.args.fn.load_image.dat).
:::
:::

::: { #func.load_image.list.args .sidebar }
##### Arguments
\

::: { #func.load_image.list.args.root_path .sidebar }
- **root_path:** Path to the root directory where image files were downloaded.; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.fn.load_image.dat .sidebar }
- **fn.load_image.dat:** Pointer to a helper function that loads a particular image file; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.folder.list .sidebar }
- **folder.list:**  (Optional, *Character*, $NULL$ by default) ; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.char_files.max .sidebar }
- **char_files.max:**  (Optional, *Integer*, $NA$ by default) ; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.char_files.seed .sidebar }
- **char_files.seed:**  (Optional, *Integer*, $NA$ by default) ; 

:::
::: { #func.load_image.list.args.random_sample .sidebar }
- **random_sample:**  (Optional, *Boolean*, $FALSE$ by default) ; 

:::
:::

::: { #func.load_image.list.details .sidebar }
##### Details
\

:::

::: { #func.load_image.list.value .sidebar }
##### Value
\

:::

::: { #func.load_image.list.code .sidebar }
##### Source Code
\

The source code of the [](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) function is shown below:
```{r func@load_image.list.s, eval=FALSE}
load_image.list <- function(root_path,
                            fn.load_image.dat,
                            folder.list = NULL, 
                            char_files.max = NA,
                            char_files.seed = NA,
                            random_sample = FALSE) {
  start <- put_start_date()
  put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Getting file path lists...")
  img.file_list <- img.file_path.get_list(root_path, 
                                          folder.list,
                                          char_files.max,
                                          char_files.seed,
                                          random_sample)
  put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
File path lists have been created. The output list structure:
%1", capture.output(str(img.file_list)))
  put_end_date(start)
  
  label_list <- as.factor(names(img.file_list))
  
  put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Loading image files...")
  
  img_list <- lapply(img.file_list, function(char.dir){
    put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Loading files from root directory:
%1...",char.dir$root_path)

    img_dat.ls <- map(char.dir$file_path.list, 
                  fn.load_image.dat)
    
    valid.idx <- sapply(img_dat.ls, function(img.dat){
      mx.bin <- img.dat[1,,]
      mode(mx.bin) <- "numeric"
      
      sum(mx.bin) > 0
    })
    
    ls <- list(img.list = img_dat.ls[valid.idx], 
               fpath.list = char.dir$file_path.list[valid.idx])
    
    stopifnot(length(ls$img.list) == length(ls$fpath.list))

    put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Completed Loading files from directory:
%1.",char.dir$root_path)
    put_end_date(start)
    ls
  })
  
  put_log("Function `load_image.list`:
Image files have been loaded. The output list structure:
%1", capture.output(str(img_list)))
  
  list(label.list = label_list,
       img.list = img_list)
}

```

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
The source code of the [](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L4) function is also available in the [Data processing functions](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) section of the [data.helper.functions.R](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) script on _GitHub_.
:::
:::

#### [load.img_trimmed](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L) Function {#func.load.img_trimmed}
\

This is a specialized utility function designed to read an image file, dynamically detect whether it contains nonzero pixel data, optionally trim whitespace or empty borders around the visual features using the [magick package](https://docs.ropensci.org/magick/index.html), and extract its raw data matrix structure.

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.usage .sidebar }
##### [Usage](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-scripts/ds.train2trimmed_img.dat.R#L15)
\

```{r func@load.img_trimmed.u, eval=FALSE}
  train.img_dat.list <- load_image.list(root_path = img.train_root.dir,
                                        fn.load_image.dat = load.img_trimmed,
                                        folder.list = NULL,
                                        char_files.max = NA,
                                        char_files.seed = NA,
                                        random_sample = FALSE)
```

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
In the *code snippet* above, a pointer to *this function* is passed in the [fn.load_image.dat](#func.load_image.list.args.fn.load_image.dat) argument to the [load_image.list](#func.load_image.list) function described above in *this Section*.
:::
:::

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.args .sidebar }
##### Arguments
\

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.args.file_path .sidebar }
- **file_path:** Path to the image file to load. 

:::
:::

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.details .sidebar }
##### Details
\

Below is the *step-by-step execution flow* of the function:

1. ([Line 288](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L288)) ***Image Loading:*** The function begins by reading the image file from disk into memory as an object using [magick::image_read](https://docs.ropensci.org/magick/reference/editing.html).
2. ([Lines 291-294](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L291-L294)) ***Matrix Conversion & Validation:*** Converts the loaded image into a numeric matrix representation using the user-defined helper function [magick_img2matrix] described below in *this Section.

3. ([Lines 296-298](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L296-L298) ***Image Validation & Conditional Cropping:*** Evaluates the maximum value of this matrix to check whether the image is entirely blank or empty. If valid content exists (the maximum pixel value is greater than zero), it applies [magick::image_trim](https://docs.ropensci.org/magick/reference/editing.html) to automatically crop out uniform background borders or whitespace, centering the content around the core visual features.
4. [(Line 300](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L300)) ***Data Extraction:*** Finally, it extracts and returns the underlying raw pixel buffer data using the [magick::image_data](https://docs.ropensci.org/magick/reference/editing.html#details) helper function.

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
..:::
:::

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.value .sidebar }
##### Value
\

:::

::: { #func.load.img_trimmed.code .sidebar }
##### Source Code
\

The [source code](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L287) of the function is shown below:
```{r func@load.img_trimmed.s, eval=FALSE}
load.img_trimmed <- function(file_path) {
  img <- magick::image_read(file_path)
  # plot(img)
  
  img.trimmed <- as.matrix(c(0))
  max(img.trimmed)
  
  img.mx <- magick_img2matrix(img)
  
  if (max(img.mx) > 0) {
    img.trimmed <- image_trim(img)
  }
  
  magick::image_data(img)
}
```

:::

\newpage

#### [magick_img2matrix](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L485) Function {#func.}
\

This is a lightweight utility that converts a [Magick Image object](https://docs.ropensci.org/magick/reference/editing.html#details) into a *normalized numeric matrix of pixel intensities*.


::: { #func.magick_img2matrix.usage .sidebar }
##### [Usage](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L294)
\

```{r data-helper@l294, eval=FALSE}
img.mx <- magick_img2matrix(img)
```

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
In the *code snippet* above, *this function* is called internally from the [load.img_trimmed](#func.load.img_trimmed) function described above in *this Section*.
:::
:::

::: { #func.magick_img2matrix.args .sidebar }
##### Arguments
\

::: { #func.magick_img2matrix.args.img .sidebar }
- **img:** A [Magick Image object](https://docs.ropensci.org/magick/reference/editing.html#details) (typically processed, resized, or filtered prior to conversion). 

:::
:::

::: { #func.magick_img2matrix.details .sidebar }
##### Details
\

Below is the *step-by-step execution flow* of the function:

1. ([Line 486](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L486)) ***Raw Binary Data Extraction:*** The function calls the [image_data] function to extract the underlying raw hexadecimal or integer byte-array buffer from the [Magick Image object](https://docs.ropensci.org/magick/reference/editing.html#details).
2. [(Line 487](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L487)) ***Color Channel Isolation:***
Slices the multidimensional array to isolate the primary color channel matrix. For grayscale or black-and-white pipeline images (as in our case), this captures the single intensity plane.
3. ([Line 488](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L488)) ***Data Type Conversion:*** Explicitly casts the extracted data array elements from raw/character bytes into a numeric data type, making mathematical operations possible.
4. ([Line 489](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L489)) ***Min-Max Normalization:*** Divides the entire matrix by 255 (the maximum 8-bit color intensity value) to normalize pixel values into a clean floating-point scale ranging from 0.0 (black/background) to 1.0 

::: {.noteblock data-latex=""}
This is a utility function used internally by the other user-defined functions, as shown in the usage example above in the [Usage](#func.magick_img2matrix.usage) section of *this Description*.
:::
:::

::: { #func.magick_img2matrix.value .sidebar }
##### Value
\

:::

::: { #func.magick_img2matrix.code .sidebar }
##### Source Code
\

The [source code](https://github.com/AzKurban-edX-DS/edx.capstone.choose-your-own/blob/main/r/support-functions/data-helper.R#L485) of the function is shown below:
```{r src@magick_img2matrix, eval=FALSE}
magick_img2matrix <- function(img){
  img.dat <- image_data(img)
  mx.bin <- img.dat[1,,]
  mode(mx.bin) <- "numeric"
  mx.bin /255
}

```

:::
